title: Cordial Learning: Distributed Training with Correlated Data
title_zh: Cordial Learning:分布式训练与相关数据

paragraphs.en: We consider a distributed learning task with agents that have correlated data. Specifically, the label of an agent depends on the input of other agents for the same sample, and these inputs are also correlated. Correlated data is the reality when agents share the same environment. Existing decentralized methods, such as federated learning, ignore the structure of the problem and perform poorly on correlated data. On the other hand, centralized approaches are infeasible due to privacy and communication constraints. We introduce cordial (correlated and distributed) learning to address this gap by sharing only low-dimensional outputs between the agents while training local models to extract informative signals from peers. This distributed learning induces a game in which the loss function of each agent depends on the models of others. Assuming a linear model, we prove that cordial learning converges with probability one to a globally optimal solution, despite the nonconvex global objective. Experiments on structured multi-digit MNIST tasks demonstrate that cordial learning remains highly effective even in highly nonlinear settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一个分布式学习任务，其中智能体的数据是相关的。 具体来说，某个智能体的标签取决于同一样本下其他智能体的输入，而这些输入之间也是相关的。 当智能体共享同一环境时，相关数据就是现实情况。 现有的去中心化方法（如联邦学习）忽视了问题的结构，在处理相关数据时表现不佳。 另一方面，由于隐私和通信限制，集中式方法并不可行。 我们提出了“cordial”（相关且分布式）学习方法来解决这一问题：在训练本地模型以从同伴中提取信息性信号的同时，仅在各智能体之间共享低维输出。 这种分布式学习会引发一种博弈，其中每个智能体的损失函数都依赖于其他智能体的模型。 假设采用线性模型，我们证明了尽管全局目标函数是非凸的，cordial 学习仍能以概率一收敛到全局最优解。 在结构化多数字 MNIST 任务上的实验表明，即使在高度非线性的场景下，cordial 学习依然非常有效。

paragraphs.en: When deployed, ML systems rarely operate in a vacuum. Their data comes from a shared environment with many ML systems. Thus, the data of many ML systems can be highly correlated. Current ML architectures are trained in solitude, ignoring any interaction they may encounter after deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 部署后，机器学习系统很少在孤立环境中运行。 它们的数据来自一个包含众多机器学习系统的共享环境。 因此，许多机器学习系统的数据可能存在高度相关性。 当前的机器学习架构是在孤立状态下训练的，忽略了部署后可能遇到的任何交互。

sents.en: When deployed, ML systems rarely operate in a vacuum.
sents.zh: 部署后，机器学习系统很少在孤立环境中运行。

sents.en: Their data comes from a shared environment with many ML systems.
sents.zh: 它们的数据来自一个包含众多机器学习系统的共享环境。

sents.en: Thus, the data of many ML systems can be highly correlated.
sents.zh: 因此，许多机器学习系统的数据可能存在高度相关性。

sents.en: Current ML architectures are trained in solitude, ignoring any interaction they may encounter after deployment.
sents.zh: 当前的机器学习架构是在孤立状态下训练的，忽略了部署后可能遇到的任何交互。

paragraphs.en: In distributed learning, and federated learning (FL) in particular, all edge devices (agents) face the same learning task. The data collected by an edge device is valuable to all others since it extends their effective training dataset. FL then avoids sending explicit data to the server, maintaining user privacy, while still allowing agents to learn from each other’s data indirectly.
paragraphs.zh: 在分布式学习中，尤其是在联邦学习（FL）中，所有边缘设备（智能体）都面临相同的学习任务。 一个边缘设备收集的数据对所有其他设备都有价值，因为它能扩展它们的有效训练数据集。 联邦学习因此避免了将原始数据发送到服务器，从而保护了用户隐私，同时仍允许智能体间接地相互学习彼此的数据。

sents.en: In distributed learning, and federated learning (FL) in particular, all edge devices (agents) face the same learning task.
sents.zh: 在分布式学习中，尤其是在联邦学习（FL）中，所有边缘设备（智能体）都面临相同的学习任务。

sents.en: The data collected by an edge device is valuable to all others since it extends their effective training dataset.
sents.zh: 一个边缘设备收集的数据对所有其他设备都有价值，因为它能扩展它们的有效训练数据集。

sents.en: FL then avoids sending explicit data to the server, maintaining user privacy, while still allowing agents to learn from each other’s data indirectly.
sents.zh: 联邦学习因此避免了将原始数据发送到服务器，从而保护了用户隐私，同时仍允许智能体间接地相互学习彼此的数据。

paragraphs.en: When ML agents share an environment, one agent’s data is helpful not only because more data is better, but mostly because it shows the agent the part of the bigger picture that it cannot see alone. Technically, it means that the label of one agent depends on the input of others. Even if the agents have different ML tasks, so they cannot learn directly from others’ data, the data of others contains information that explains their label better.
paragraphs.zh: 当机器学习智能体共享一个环境时，一个智能体的数据之所以有用，不仅是因为数据越多越好，更主要的是因为它能让该智能体看到单凭自身无法察觉的整体图景的一部分。 从技术层面来说，这意味着一个智能体的标签依赖于其他智能体的输入。 即使这些智能体执行不同的机器学习任务，因此无法直接从他人的数据中学习，他人的数据仍然包含能更好地解释其标签的信息。

sents.en: When ML agents share an environment, one agent’s data is helpful not only because more data is better, but mostly because it shows the agent the part of the bigger picture that it cannot see alone.
sents.zh: 当机器学习智能体共享一个环境时，一个智能体的数据之所以有用，不仅是因为数据越多越好，更主要的是因为它能让该智能体看到单凭自身无法察觉的整体图景的一部分。

sents.en: Technically, it means that the label of one agent depends on the input of others.
sents.zh: 从技术层面来说，这意味着一个智能体的标签依赖于其他智能体的输入。

sents.en: Even if the agents have different ML tasks, so they cannot learn directly from others’ data, the data of others contains information that explains their label better.
sents.zh: 即使这些智能体执行不同的机器学习任务，因此无法直接从他人的数据中学习，他人的数据仍然包含能更好地解释其标签的信息。

paragraphs.en: The current distributed learning paradigm cannot benefit from the correlated data of ML agents that share an environment after deployment. In this paper, we introduce a new paradigm we term cordial learning (CL), since it is cor related and di stributed. Similar to FL, CL is concerned with edge devices that each have a private dataset. However, the l l -th datapoint of all devices is correlated (input and label), for every index l l .
paragraphs.zh: 当前的分布式学习范式无法从部署后共享同一环境的机器学习智能体的相关数据中获益。 在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“友好学习”（CL）的新范式，因为它具有相关性和分布式特性。 与联邦学习（FL）类似，友好学习（CL）关注的是每个设备都拥有私有数据集的边缘设备。 然而，对于每个索引 l l，所有设备的第 l l 个数据点（输入和标签）都是相关的。

sents.en: The current distributed learning paradigm cannot benefit from the correlated data of ML agents that share an environment after deployment.
sents.zh: 当前的分布式学习范式无法从部署后共享同一环境的机器学习智能体的相关数据中获益。

sents.en: In this paper, we introduce a new paradigm we term cordial learning (CL), since it is cor related and di stributed.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“友好学习”（CL）的新范式，因为它具有相关性和分布式特性。

sents.en: Similar to FL, CL is concerned with edge devices that each have a private dataset.
sents.zh: 与联邦学习（FL）类似，友好学习（CL）关注的是每个设备都拥有私有数据集的边缘设备。

sents.en: However, the l l -th datapoint of all devices is correlated (input and label), for every index l l .
sents.zh: 然而，对于每个索引 l l，所有设备的第 l l 个数据点（输入和标签）都是相关的。

paragraphs.en: CL is the practical reality in the following example applications:
paragraphs.zh: CL 在以下示例应用中具有实际意义：

paragraphs.en: Multi-Digit MNIST: Each classifier sees a handwritten digit as input. However, the digits of all agents are dependent (e.g., credit card numbers, error correction codes, or the same handwriting). For example, adjacent digits must add up to 10, or all digits tend to equal a common hidden digit.
paragraphs.zh: 多数字 MNIST：每个分类器都将一个手写数字作为输入。 然而，所有智能体的数字之间是相互依赖的（例如，信用卡号码、纠错码或相同的手写体）。 例如，相邻的数字之和必须为 10，或者所有数字都倾向于等于某个共同的隐藏数字。

sents.en: Multi-Digit MNIST: Each classifier sees a handwritten digit as input.
sents.zh: 多数字 MNIST：每个分类器都将一个手写数字作为输入。

sents.en: However, the digits of all agents are dependent (e.g., credit card numbers, error correction codes, or the same handwriting).
sents.zh: 然而，所有智能体的数字之间是相互依赖的（例如，信用卡号码、纠错码或相同的手写体）。

sents.en: For example, adjacent digits must add up to 10, or all digits tend to equal a common hidden digit.
sents.zh: 例如，相邻的数字之和必须为 10，或者所有数字都倾向于等于某个共同的隐藏数字。

paragraphs.en: Remote Sensors: The agents are sensors that collect local environmental features (e.g., temperature, vibration, gas). The task is to classify whether a global phenomenon, such as a fire or earthquake, is occurring. Since all sensors in the same region are exposed to the same event, their data (inputs and labels) are correlated. However, each sensor only observes part of the full picture. Sharing model outputs, rather than raw data, allows the agents to benefit from the collective information while meeting the communication constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 远程传感器：这些智能体是收集局部环境特征（例如温度、振动、气体）的传感器。 任务是对是否正在发生全局性现象（如火灾或地震）进行分类。 由于同一区域的所有传感器都受到相同事件的影响，它们的数据（输入和标签）是相关的。 然而，每个传感器只能观察到完整情况的一部分。 共享模型输出而非原始数据，可以让智能体在满足通信约束的同时，利用集体信息带来的优势。

sents.en: Remote Sensors: The agents are sensors that collect local environmental features (e.g., temperature, vibration, gas).
sents.zh: 远程传感器：这些智能体是收集局部环境特征（例如温度、振动、气体）的传感器。

sents.en: The task is to classify whether a global phenomenon, such as a fire or earthquake, is occurring.
sents.zh: 任务是对是否正在发生全局性现象（如火灾或地震）进行分类。

sents.en: Since all sensors in the same region are exposed to the same event, their data (inputs and labels) are correlated.
sents.zh: 由于同一区域的所有传感器都受到相同事件的影响，它们的数据（输入和标签）是相关的。

sents.en: However, each sensor only observes part of the full picture.
sents.zh: 然而，每个传感器只能观察到完整情况的一部分。

sents.en: Sharing model outputs, rather than raw data, allows the agents to benefit from the collective information while meeting the communication constraints.
sents.zh: 共享模型输出而非原始数据，可以让智能体在满足通信约束的同时，利用集体信息带来的优势。

paragraphs.en: Medical Wearables in Shared Environments: Each agent monitors a different patient using wearable sensors that record local physiological signals (e.g., heart rate, skin temperature). The task is to detect the onset of a disease. When patients are nearby, such as on a hospital ward or during an outbreak, their health outcomes are correlated, as infection spreads. In this case, leveraging cross-patient correlations can improve prediction accuracy. However, direct data sharing is prohibited due to privacy constraints. A distributed learning approach that shares only model outputs can enable collaboration without compromising sensitive health data.
paragraphs.zh: 共享环境中的医疗可穿戴设备：每个智能体都使用可穿戴传感器监测不同的患者，这些传感器会记录局部的生理信号（例如心率、皮肤温度）。 该任务旨在检测疾病的发病初期。 当患者彼此靠近时，例如在医院病房内或疫情爆发期间，由于感染会传播，他们的健康结果会相互关联。 在这种情况下，利用跨患者的相关性可以提高预测准确性。 然而，出于隐私保护的考虑，直接共享数据是被禁止的。 一种仅共享模型输出的分布式学习方法，可以在不泄露敏感健康数据的前提下实现协作。

sents.en: Medical Wearables in Shared Environments: Each agent monitors a different patient using wearable sensors that record local physiological signals (e.g., heart rate, skin temperature).
sents.zh: 共享环境中的医疗可穿戴设备：每个智能体都使用可穿戴传感器监测不同的患者，这些传感器会记录局部的生理信号（例如心率、皮肤温度）。

sents.zh: 该任务旨在检测疾病的发病初期。

sents.zh: 在这种情况下，利用跨患者的相关性可以提高预测准确性。

sents.en: However, direct data sharing is prohibited due to privacy constraints.
sents.zh: 然而，出于隐私保护的考虑，直接共享数据是被禁止的。

sents.en: A distributed learning approach that shares only model outputs can enable collaboration without compromising sensitive health data.
sents.zh: 一种仅共享模型输出的分布式学习方法，可以在不泄露敏感健康数据的前提下实现协作。

paragraphs.en: Formation Control: A group of moving agents often has to maintain a target formation. Examples are platoons of autonomous vehicles or drones. Each vehicle collects local sensor data (e.g., LiDAR, radar, velocity) and must classify whether to accelerate, maintain speed, or decelerate. Since vehicles influence each other’s decisions, especially those of their neighbors, their data is correlated. However, each vehicle observes only partial information. Sharing embedded outputs rather than raw sensory data allows collaborative real-time decision-making while preserving autonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 队形控制：一组移动的智能体通常需要维持目标队形。 例如，自主车辆或无人机的编队。 每辆车都会收集局部传感器数据（例如，激光雷达、雷达、速度），并必须判断是加速、保持速度还是减速。 由于车辆会影响彼此的决定，尤其是邻近车辆的决定，因此它们的数据存在相关性。 然而，每辆车只能观察到部分信息。 共享嵌入式输出而非原始传感器数据，可以在保持自主性的同时实现协作式实时决策。

sents.zh: 队形控制：一组移动的智能体通常需要维持目标队形。

sents.en: Examples are platoons of autonomous vehicles or drones.
sents.zh: 例如，自主车辆或无人机的编队。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to design a distributed training scheme that achieves close to optimal performance in this cordial learning scenario, while maintaining low communication overhead. We measure performance by the sum of loss functions of all agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是设计一种分布式训练方案，在保持较低通信开销的同时，在此友好学习场景中实现接近最优的性能。 我们通过所有智能体的损失函数之和来衡量性能。

sents.en: Our goal is to design a distributed training scheme that achieves close to optimal performance in this cordial learning scenario, while maintaining low communication overhead.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是设计一种分布式训练方案，在保持较低通信开销的同时，在此友好学习场景中实现接近最优的性能。

sents.en: We measure performance by the sum of loss functions of all agents.
sents.zh: 我们通过所有智能体的损失函数之和来衡量性能。

paragraphs.en: A centralized architecture would collect data from all agents and train one large model to fit their combined input to their combined labels. Then, the central server is needed in real-time, so all devices can send their input data to the server and receive the result back. Such a centralized architecture requires significant communication between a central server and the agents to collect all their data, both in training and in real-time. Then the central server must train a huge ML model with a large dataset to obtain all agent models. Perhaps even worse, collecting user data in the central server can violate user privacy. It also creates a single point of failure. Communication, latency, complexity, and privacy are known issues with any centralized architecture. In the context of cordial learning, the centralized architecture is also data-inefficient. The classification tasks are inherently distributed in the sense that each agent observes a different part of the whole problem. A centralized agent will waste a lot of data “understanding” the distributed nature of the problem (e.g., that there are N N digits in the multi-digit example). In other words, since the problem is distributed, a data-efficient architecture will also have to be distributed.
paragraphs.zh: 集中式架构会从所有智能体收集数据，并训练一个大型模型，使其能够适应这些智能体的联合输入与联合标签。 此外，中央服务器需要实时运行，以便所有设备都能将输入数据发送到服务器，并接收返回的结果。 这种集中式架构在训练和实时运行期间都需要中央服务器与各个智能体之间进行大量通信，以收集它们的所有数据。 接着，中央服务器必须使用大型数据集训练一个巨大的机器学习模型，从而获得所有智能体模型。 更糟糕的是，在中央服务器上收集用户数据可能会侵犯用户隐私。 这也会造成单点故障。 通信、延迟、复杂性和隐私问题是任何集中式架构中已知的问题。 在友好学习（cordial learning）的语境下，集中式架构还存在数据效率低下的问题。 分类任务本质上是分布式的，因为每个智能体观察到的都是整个问题中不同的部分。 一个集中式智能体会浪费大量数据来“理解”问题的分布式特性（例如，多位数示例中存在 N 个数字）。 换言之，由于问题是分布式的，因此数据高效的架构也必须是分布式的。

sents.en: A centralized architecture would collect data from all agents and train one large model to fit their combined input to their combined labels.
sents.zh: 集中式架构会从所有智能体收集数据，并训练一个大型模型，使其能够适应这些智能体的联合输入与联合标签。

sents.en: Then, the central server is needed in real-time, so all devices can send their input data to the server and receive the result back.
sents.zh: 此外，中央服务器需要实时运行，以便所有设备都能将输入数据发送到服务器，并接收返回的结果。

sents.en: Such a centralized architecture requires significant communication between a central server and the agents to collect all their data, both in training and in real-time.
sents.zh: 这种集中式架构在训练和实时运行期间都需要中央服务器与各个智能体之间进行大量通信，以收集它们的所有数据。

sents.en: Then the central server must train a huge ML model with a large dataset to obtain all agent models.
sents.zh: 接着，中央服务器必须使用大型数据集训练一个巨大的机器学习模型，从而获得所有智能体模型。

sents.en: Perhaps even worse, collecting user data in the central server can violate user privacy.
sents.zh: 更糟糕的是，在中央服务器上收集用户数据可能会侵犯用户隐私。

sents.en: It also creates a single point of failure.
sents.zh: 这也会造成单点故障。

sents.en: Communication, latency, complexity, and privacy are known issues with any centralized architecture.
sents.zh: 通信、延迟、复杂性和隐私问题是任何集中式架构中已知的问题。

sents.en: In the context of cordial learning, the centralized architecture is also data-inefficient.
sents.zh: 在友好学习（cordial learning）的语境下，集中式架构还存在数据效率低下的问题。

sents.en: The classification tasks are inherently distributed in the sense that each agent observes a different part of the whole problem.
sents.zh: 分类任务本质上是分布式的，因为每个智能体观察到的都是整个问题中不同的部分。

sents.en: A centralized agent will waste a lot of data “understanding” the distributed nature of the problem (e.g., that there are N N digits in the multi-digit example).
sents.zh: 一个集中式智能体会浪费大量数据来“理解”问题的分布式特性（例如，多位数示例中存在 N 个数字）。

sents.en: In other words, since the problem is distributed, a data-efficient architecture will also have to be distributed.
sents.zh: 换言之，由于问题是分布式的，因此数据高效的架构也必须是分布式的。

paragraphs.en: In CL, the learning tasks of the agents are intertwined. If two agents each observe a digit, knowing that both digits are even or odd together, then each agent only needs the other agent to detect the parity of its digit. However, being able to classify a digit is very much related to classifying its parity. On the other hand, only sending the decision is not enough information. If an agent believes that the digit is six, but digits nine and three together are more likely, then this information is lost. A similar tradeoff exists in remote sensors that detect fire - even if one sensor is sure that currently there is no fire in its region, some indicators can help sensors in more sensitive areas to lower their detection threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 在协作学习中，智能体的学习任务是相互交织的。 如果两个智能体各自观察一个数字，并且知道这两个数字同时为偶数或奇数，那么每个智能体只需另一个智能体来检测其自身数字的奇偶性。 然而，能否对某个数字进行分类，与其奇偶性的分类密切相关。 另一方面，仅发送决策本身并不足以提供足够的信息。 如果一个智能体认为该数字是六，但数字九和三同时出现的可能性更大，那么这一信息就会丢失。 在用于探测火灾的远程传感器中也存在类似的权衡——即使某个传感器确定其区域内目前没有火灾，某些指标仍可以帮助更敏感区域的传感器降低其探测阈值。

sents.en: In CL, the learning tasks of the agents are intertwined.
sents.zh: 在协作学习中，智能体的学习任务是相互交织的。

sents.zh: 如果一个智能体认为该数字是六，但数字九和三同时出现的可能性更大，那么这一信息就会丢失。

sents.zh: 在用于探测火灾的远程传感器中也存在类似的权衡——即使某个传感器确定其区域内目前没有火灾，某些指标仍可以帮助更敏感区域的传感器降低其探测阈值。

paragraphs.en: We propose using an embedded output as the basic communication unit between the agents. The embedding is in the dimension of the output, a short vector compared to the input vectors. This embedded output is similar to the softmax output of a neural network (NN), but not the same. The softmax output of our agents is computed after incorporating the information from other agents, while the embedded output is processed before.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提议使用嵌入输出作为智能体之间的基本通信单元。 该嵌入位于输出的维度中，与输入向量相比是一个较短的向量。 这种嵌入输出类似于神经网络（NN）的 softmax 输出，但并非完全相同。 我们的智能体的 softmax 输出是在融合了其他智能体的信息之后计算的，而嵌入输出则在此之前就已经处理完毕。

sents.en: We propose using an embedded output as the basic communication unit between the agents.
sents.zh: 我们提议使用嵌入输出作为智能体之间的基本通信单元。

sents.en: The embedding is in the dimension of the output, a short vector compared to the input vectors.
sents.zh: 该嵌入位于输出的维度中，与输入向量相比是一个较短的向量。

sents.zh: 这种嵌入输出类似于神经网络（NN）的 softmax 输出，但并非完全相同。

sents.en: The softmax output of our agents is computed after incorporating the information from other agents, while the embedded output is processed before.
sents.zh: 我们的智能体的 softmax 输出是在融合了其他智能体的信息之后计算的，而嵌入输出则在此之前就已经处理完毕。

paragraphs.en: In CL, agents maintain coordination layers dedicated to extracting useful information from the inputs they receive from other agents for the same sample. Thus, each agent simultaneously trains its NN along with these additional layers. This introduces a unique coupling (or interaction) between the agents. The weights of the NN of agent n n affect not only the loss of agent n n , but also the loss of all other agents, since it changes the information they receive from agent n n . As our analysis reveals, this interaction requires careful design. The sum of loss functions is nonconvex even in the linear regression case. Thus, many suboptimal stationary points may exist.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CL 中，智能体维护专门的协调层，用于从同一样本的其他智能体接收到的输入中提取有用信息。 因此，每个智能体都会同时训练其神经网络以及这些附加层。 这在智能体之间引入了一种独特的耦合（或相互作用）。 智能体 n 的神经网络的权重不仅会影响智能体 n 的损失，还会影响所有其他智能体的损失，因为它会改变它们从智能体 n 接收到的信息。 正如我们的分析所揭示的，这种相互作用需要精心设计。 即使在线性回归的情况下，损失函数之和也是非凸的。 因此，可能存在许多次优的稳点。

sents.en: In CL, agents maintain coordination layers dedicated to extracting useful information from the inputs they receive from other agents for the same sample.
sents.zh: 在 CL 中，智能体维护专门的协调层，用于从同一样本的其他智能体接收到的输入中提取有用信息。

sents.en: Thus, each agent simultaneously trains its NN along with these additional layers.
sents.zh: 因此，每个智能体都会同时训练其神经网络以及这些附加层。

sents.en: This introduces a unique coupling (or interaction) between the agents.
sents.zh: 这在智能体之间引入了一种独特的耦合（或相互作用）。

sents.en: The weights of the NN of agent n n affect not only the loss of agent n n , but also the loss of all other agents, since it changes the information they receive from agent n n .
sents.zh: 智能体 n 的神经网络的权重不仅会影响智能体 n 的损失，还会影响所有其他智能体的损失，因为它会改变它们从智能体 n 接收到的信息。

sents.en: As our analysis reveals, this interaction requires careful design.
sents.zh: 正如我们的分析所揭示的，这种相互作用需要精心设计。

sents.en: The sum of loss functions is nonconvex even in the linear regression case.
sents.zh: 即使在线性回归的情况下，损失函数之和也是非凸的。

sents.en: Thus, many suboptimal stationary points may exist.
sents.zh: 因此，可能存在许多次优的稳点。

paragraphs.en: For the linear theoretical model, we show that if the learning of the “coordination layers” is slower than the learning of the embedding layers, then CL is guaranteed to converge to the optimal agent models that minimize the nonconvex sum of loss functions. This happens even though each agent locally optimizes only its loss function, ignoring the effect of its model on the loss of others. This makes CL a scalable, distributed training algorithm that can incorporate many devices, with little communication overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 对于线性理论模型，我们证明了：如果“协调层”的学习速度比嵌入层的学习速度慢，那么 CL 就一定能收敛到使非凸损失函数之和最小化的最优智能体模型。 尽管每个智能体仅局部优化自身的损失函数，而忽略其模型对其他智能体损失的影响，这种情况依然会发生。 这使得 CL 成为一种可扩展的分布式训练算法，能够整合大量设备，且通信开销极小。

sents.en: For the linear theoretical model, we show that if the learning of the “coordination layers” is slower than the learning of the embedding layers, then CL is guaranteed to converge to the optimal agent models that minimize the nonconvex sum of loss functions.
sents.zh: 对于线性理论模型，我们证明了：如果“协调层”的学习速度比嵌入层的学习速度慢，那么 CL 就一定能收敛到使非凸损失函数之和最小化的最优智能体模型。

sents.zh: 尽管每个智能体仅局部优化自身的损失函数，而忽略其模型对其他智能体损失的影响，这种情况依然会发生。

sents.en: This makes CL a scalable, distributed training algorithm that can incorporate many devices, with little communication overhead.
sents.zh: 这使得 CL 成为一种可扩展的分布式训练算法，能够整合大量设备，且通信开销极小。

paragraphs.en: Our work belongs to the growing literature on on-device learning. When the datasets of different agents are independent, each agent has a disjoint dataset for the same classification task. This corresponds to the classic on-device learning setting addressed by federated learning ( Kairouz et al., 2021 ; Mitra et al., 2021 ; Koloskova et al., 2022 ) , where no inter-agent correlation exists. Reducing the communication of federated learning and distributed SGD has been recognized as crucial ( Wang and Joshi, 2021 ) . Unlike CL, FL is not designed to deal with correlated data. Additionally, FL requires that all devices have the same architecture so that the weights can be averaged. In CL, different devices can have different architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作属于日益丰富的设备端学习文献领域。 当不同智能体的数据集相互独立时，每个智能体在执行相同分类任务时都拥有互不重叠的数据集。 这对应于联邦学习所处理的经典设备端学习设定（Kairouz et al., 2021；Mitra et al., 2021；Koloskova et al., 2022），其中智能体之间不存在相关性。 减少联邦学习和分布式 SGD 的通信量已被公认为至关重要（Wang and Joshi, 2021）。 与 CL 不同，FL 并未设计用于处理相关数据。 此外，FL 要求所有设备具有相同的架构，以便可以对权重进行平均。 在 CL 中，不同设备可以具有不同的架构。

sents.en: Our work belongs to the growing literature on on-device learning.
sents.zh: 我们的工作属于日益丰富的设备端学习文献领域。

paragraphs.en: In Bistritz et al. (2020) , we designed a distributed distillation scheme in which agents share softmax outputs on common unlabeled data to learn from each other’s private data without revealing it. Since softmax is a short vector, the resulting communication overhead is dramatically lower than with FL, and devices with different ML architectures can participate in the training. Distributed distillation does not deal with correlated data. In CL, agents share embedded outputs to learn from other agents about the same sample they are currently learning from.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Bistritz 等人（2020）的研究中，我们设计了一种分布式蒸馏方案，其中智能体在共同的未标注数据上共享 softmax 输出，从而能够在不泄露各自私有数据的情况下相互学习。由于 softmax 是一个短向量，因此由此产生的通信开销远低于联邦学习（FL），并且具有不同机器学习架构的设备也可以参与训练。分布式蒸馏无法处理相关数据。在协同学习（CL）中，智能体通过共享嵌入输出，就当前正在学习的相同样本向其他智能体学习。

paragraphs.en: Game theory and learning have recently become intertwined. The literature on learning in games studies the interaction between players who learn to maximize their reward. Then, convergence to a Nash equilibrium (NE) is guaranteed for various distributed algorithms in many scenarios ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Ratliff et al., 2016 ; Bistritz et al., 2022 ; Chasnov et al., 2020 ; Mazumdar et al., 2020 ) . We study the opposite - how games can help in learning. Game theory has already been proven insightful for learning in generative adversarial networks ( Goodfellow et al., 2020 , GANs;) . Unlike the zero-sum games studied in GANs, our players are cooperative and each is an individual ML system ( Bistritz and Bambos, 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 博弈论与学习近来已紧密交织在一起。 关于游戏中学习的文献研究了玩家之间相互作用，这些玩家通过学习来最大化自身奖励。 此外，在许多场景中，各种分布式算法都能保证收敛于纳什均衡（NE）（Xu et al., 2025 ; Ratliff et al., 2016 ; Bistritz et al., 2022 ; Chasnov et al., 2020 ; Mazumdar et al., 2020）。 我们研究的是相反的问题——游戏如何能够促进学习。 博弈论已被证明对生成对抗网络中的学习具有深刻的启发意义（Goodfellow et al., 2020, GANs;）。 与GANs中研究的零和博弈不同，我们的玩家是合作性的，且每个玩家都是一个独立的机器学习系统（Bistritz and Bambos, 2020）。

paragraphs.en: Distributed learning with linear models that observe local measurements with correlated noise was studied in Hong et al. (2022) . The risk functions include a term that penalizes for deviating from neighboring models. In our scenario, players do not necessarily converge to the same model. On the contrary, players may face non-identically distributed data and need to take heterogeneous actions (e.g., the medical wearables example above).
paragraphs.zh: Hong 等人（2022）研究了分布式学习，其中线性模型会观测到存在相关噪声的局部测量值。 风险函数中包含一个用于惩罚偏离邻近模型的项。 在我们的场景中，玩家并不一定会收敛到相同的模型。 相反，玩家可能面临非同分布的数据，并需要采取异构的行动（例如，上文提到的医疗可穿戴设备示例）。

sents.en: Distributed learning with linear models that observe local measurements with correlated noise was studied in Hong et al. (2022) .
sents.zh: Hong 等人（2022）研究了分布式学习，其中线性模型会观测到存在相关噪声的局部测量值。

sents.en: The risk functions include a term that penalizes for deviating from neighboring models.
sents.zh: 风险函数中包含一个用于惩罚偏离邻近模型的项。

sents.zh: 在我们的场景中，玩家并不一定会收敛到相同的模型。

sents.en: On the contrary, players may face non-identically distributed data and need to take heterogeneous actions (e.g., the medical wearables example above).
sents.zh: 相反，玩家可能面临非同分布的数据，并需要采取异构的行动（例如，上文提到的医疗可穿戴设备示例）。

paragraphs.en: Performative prediction studies a game scenario where the actions of one learner affect both the risk scores and the distributions of the data of the others ( Narang et al., 2023 ; Lin and Zrnic, 2024 ; Perdomo et al., 2020 ) . The goal is to compute an equilibrium that predicts the behavior of selfish learners. In contrast, our agents are cooperative. Furthermore, given the distribution, the datapoints of different players in Narang et al. (2023) are independent, while ours are correlated. Finally, Narang et al. (2023) assumes that players can observe each other’s actions, which is unacceptable in our case since it would mean that players can observe the model parameters of everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 表演性预测研究了一种博弈场景，其中一名学习者的行为会影响其他学习者的风险评分和数据分布（Narang 等人，2023；Lin 和 Zrnic，2024；Perdomo 等人，2020）。其目标是计算一个能够预测自私学习者行为的均衡状态。相比之下，我们的智能体是合作性的。此外，在 Narang 等人（2023）的研究中，给定数据分布后，不同玩家的数据点是相互独立的，而我们的数据点则是相关的。最后，Narang 等人（2023）假设玩家可以观察到彼此的行为，但在我们的情境中这是不可接受的，因为这意味着玩家可以观察到所有人的模型参数。

paragraphs.en: CL resembles vertical federated learning (VFL) ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . In VFL, the different agents have different nonoverlapping features of the same sample. This means that the inputs of the agents are correlated. However, in VFL, there is one learning task and one label, which only the “active agent” possesses. In contrast, in CL, each agent has its own local learning task and its own label, and the labels are correlated between agents. In this sense, VFL is a special case of CL, where all labels are identical and only one agent orchestrates the learning.
paragraphs.zh: CL 类似于垂直联邦学习（VFL）（Liu 等人，2024）。 在 VFL 中，不同的智能体拥有同一样本的不同、互不重叠的特征。 这意味着各智能体的输入是相关的。 然而，在 VFL 中只有一个学习任务和一个标签，且只有“主动智能体”拥有它们。 相比之下，在 CL 中，每个智能体都有自己的局部学习任务和标签，并且各智能体之间的标签是相关的。 从这个意义上说，VFL 是 CL 的一种特殊情况：所有标签都相同，且只有一个智能体负责协调学习过程。

sents.en: CL resembles vertical federated learning (VFL) ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: CL 类似于垂直联邦学习（VFL）（Liu 等人，2024）。

sents.en: In VFL, the different agents have different nonoverlapping features of the same sample.
sents.zh: 在 VFL 中，不同的智能体拥有同一样本的不同、互不重叠的特征。

sents.en: This means that the inputs of the agents are correlated.
sents.zh: 这意味着各智能体的输入是相关的。

sents.en: However, in VFL, there is one learning task and one label, which only the “active agent” possesses.
sents.zh: 然而，在 VFL 中只有一个学习任务和一个标签，且只有“主动智能体”拥有它们。

sents.en: In contrast, in CL, each agent has its own local learning task and its own label, and the labels are correlated between agents.
sents.zh: 相比之下，在 CL 中，每个智能体都有自己的局部学习任务和标签，并且各智能体之间的标签是相关的。

sents.en: In this sense, VFL is a special case of CL, where all labels are identical and only one agent orchestrates the learning.
sents.zh: 从这个意义上说，VFL 是 CL 的一种特殊情况：所有标签都相同，且只有一个智能体负责协调学习过程。

paragraphs.en: Multitask learning (MTL) ( Maurer, 2006 ) is also concerned with intertwined learning tasks. However, MTL trains a centralized architecture and not distributed agents. Even more important is that MTL is trained for tasks that occur asynchronously in real-time. In contrast, CL trains distributed agents that learn from synchronous correlated data points in real-time.
paragraphs.zh: 多任务学习（MTL）（Maurer，2006）也关注相互交织的学习任务。 然而，MTL训练的是集中式架构，而非分布式智能体。 更重要的是，MTL是为在实时环境中异步发生的学习任务而训练的。 相比之下，CL训练的是分布式智能体，这些智能体能够在实时环境中从同步的相关数据点中学习。

paragraphs.en: While successive classification shares the idea of interdependent models, it differs from our setting in several fundamental ways. In pipelines such as Faster R-CNN ( Ren et al., 2015 ) , the region proposal network and the final classifier share a common feature extraction backbone, introducing architectural coupling. However, the overall computation proceeds sequentially: region proposals are generated and then classified. In contrast, CL involves a network of distributed agents, each owning a private task and dataset. These agents do not share a backbone or data. Instead, they coordinate through shared latent representations generated during training. Information flows bidirectionally, and learning is formulated as a nonconvex game where each agent’s model parameters affect others.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管连续分类方法也采用了相互依赖的模型这一理念，但它在几个基本方面与我们的设定有所不同。 在 Faster R-CNN（Ren 等人，2015）等流程中，区域提议网络和最终分类器共享一个公共的特征提取主干网络，从而引入了架构上的耦合。 然而，整体的计算过程是顺序进行的：首先生成区域提议，然后进行分类。 相比之下，CL 涉及一个由分布式智能体组成的网络，每个智能体都拥有自己的私有任务和数据集。 这些智能体之间不共享主干网络或数据。 相反，它们通过训练过程中生成的共享潜在表示进行协调。 信息以双向流动，而学习过程则被建模为一个非凸博弈，其中每个智能体的模型参数都会影响其他智能体。

This is equivalent to a large learning model that faces a prediction task with an m ​ N mN -dimensional output. By construction, the centralized approach can achieve the minimal training loss. However, centralized training will require each agent to share all its data with all others. Then the central server will still be needed in real-time to collect the inputs from all devices, process them, and send back the results to the agents. The communication overhead of such sharing is infeasible in large networks, especially in real-time. Moreover, sharing explicit data violates user privacy. Last but not least, when the task structure is distributed (e.g., remote fire sensors or medical sensors), a distributed architecture is more data-efficient than a centralized one that wastes data to understand the distributed structure of the problem.

paragraphs.en: We propose a novel algorithm, termed cordial learning (correlated and distributed learning), to deal with the correlated data scenario. In cordial learning (CL), agents only share their embedded outputs and never their explicit datapoints. Then, each agent’s model includes coordination layers to process the inputs from other agents. The pseudocode for CL is given in Algorithm 1. To keep it tractable, our theoretical model is linear ( Maurer, 2006 ) , but CL applies more broadly to any scenario in which training data is correlated between agents. We support this claim with experiments on deep neural networks (see Section 6).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种名为“协同学习”（相关与分布式学习）的新算法，用于处理数据相关性的场景。 在协同学习（CL）中，智能体仅共享其嵌入输出，而绝不共享显式的数据点。 随后，每个智能体的模型都会包含协调层，以处理来自其他智能体的输入。 CL 的伪代码见算法 1。 为保持可处理性，我们的理论模型是线性的（Maurer, 2006），但 CL 更广泛地适用于任何训练数据在智能体之间存在相关性的场景。 我们通过深度神经网络实验支持这一主张（参见第 6 节）。

sents.en: We propose a novel algorithm, termed cordial learning (correlated and distributed learning), to deal with the correlated data scenario.
sents.zh: 我们提出了一种名为“协同学习”（相关与分布式学习）的新算法，用于处理数据相关性的场景。

sents.en: In cordial learning (CL), agents only share their embedded outputs and never their explicit datapoints.
sents.zh: 在协同学习（CL）中，智能体仅共享其嵌入输出，而绝不共享显式的数据点。

sents.en: Then, each agent’s model includes coordination layers to process the inputs from other agents.
sents.zh: 随后，每个智能体的模型都会包含协调层，以处理来自其他智能体的输入。

sents.en: The pseudocode for CL is given in Algorithm 1.
sents.zh: CL 的伪代码见算法 1。

sents.en: To keep it tractable, our theoretical model is linear ( Maurer, 2006 ) , but CL applies more broadly to any scenario in which training data is correlated between agents.
sents.zh: 为保持可处理性，我们的理论模型是线性的（Maurer, 2006），但 CL 更广泛地适用于任何训练数据在智能体之间存在相关性的场景。

sents.en: We support this claim with experiments on deep neural networks (see Section 6).
sents.zh: 我们通过深度神经网络实验支持这一主张（参见第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: CL is distributed since each agent calculates the gradients over its local parameters only. Instead of optimizing the global objective ( 7 ) directly, each agent optimizes its local objective given in ( 6 ). The local loss function depends on M i , Λ 1 i , … , Λ N i M_{i},\Lambda_{1}^{i},\ldots,\Lambda_{N}^{i} for agent i i , where M j M_{j} for j ≠ i j\neq i , the models of other agents, are treated as constants.
paragraphs.zh: CL 是分布式的，因为每个智能体仅计算其局部参数的梯度。 每个智能体不直接优化全局目标（7），而是优化公式（6）中给出的局部目标。 对于智能体 i，局部损失函数依赖于 M_i、Λ_1^i、…、Λ_N^i，其中当 j ≠ i 时，其他智能体的模型 M_j 被视为常数。

paragraphs.en: Centralized gradient descent that optimizes ( 7 ) would require each agent i i to know the gradient of the loss function of agent j j with respect to M i M_{i} . CL bypasses that, as each agent runs a two-time-scale SGD to minimize its loss function ( 6 ) with respect to its parameters alone. The stochastic gradients of an agent employ information sent by others.
paragraphs.zh: 用于优化 (7) 的集中式梯度下降法需要每个智能体 i 都知道智能体 j 的损失函数相对于 M_i 的梯度。 CL 绕过了这一点，因为每个智能体都运行一个双时间尺度 SGD，仅针对其自身参数来最小化其损失函数 (6)。 某个智能体的随机梯度会利用其他智能体发送的信息。

paragraphs.en: In general, SGD does not converge in games. When it does converge, it is to a stationary point that, under mild conditions, is a Nash equilibrium (NE) ( Mazumdar et al., 2020 ) , which is typically socially inefficient ( Roughgarden, 2015 ; Sessa et al., 2019 ) . Surprisingly, our main theorem shows that in the game induced by the designed loss functions in ( 6 ) , a two-time-scale SGD converges to a global minimum of the sum of loss functions.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，SGD 在游戏场景中不会收敛。 当它确实收敛时，会收敛到一个稳点；在温和条件下，该稳点是一个纳什均衡（NE）（Mazumdar 等人，2020），而纳什均衡通常是社会效率低下的（Roughgarden，2015；Sessa 等人，2019）。 令人惊讶的是，我们的主要定理表明，在由（6）中设计的损失函数所诱导的游戏中，一种双时间尺度的 SGD 会收敛到损失函数之和的全局最小值。

sents.en: In general, SGD does not converge in games.

sents.en: When it does converge, it is to a stationary point that, under mild conditions, is a Nash equilibrium (NE) ( Mazumdar et al., 2020 ) , which is typically socially inefficient ( Roughgarden, 2015 ; Sessa et al., 2019 ) .
sents.zh: 当它确实收敛时，会收敛到一个稳点；在温和条件下，该稳点是一个纳什均衡（NE）（Mazumdar 等人，2020），而纳什均衡通常是社会效率低下的（Roughgarden，2015；Sessa 等人，2019）。

sents.en: Surprisingly, our main theorem shows that in the game induced by the designed loss functions in ( 6 ) , a two-time-scale SGD converges to a global minimum of the sum of loss functions.

paragraphs.en: CL utilizes common randomness between the agents, which generate the correlated samples that correspond to the same sample ID. This can be implemented using traditional epochs where agents go over all datapoints in a pre-agreed order.
paragraphs.zh: CL 利用了智能体之间的公共随机性，这些智能体生成与相同样本 ID 相对应的关联样本。 这可以通过传统的轮次来实现，其中智能体按照预先约定好的顺序遍历所有数据点。

paragraphs.en: The communication between agents in CL can be implemented with or without a central server. The agents communicate both in training and online after deployment, to extract information from the correlation between their online test (unlabeled) samples using the coordination layers they trained offline. paragraphs.en: The next lemma bounds the variances of our stochastic gradients. We see that Λ j i \Lambda_{j}^{i} converges to minimal error only since M j M_{j} converges to A j ∗ A_{j}^{*} for other agents, which indicates that learning is coupled between agents. Nevertheless, the convergence of Λ j i \Lambda_{j}^{i} also helps learning M i M_{i} , since the variance of the stochastic gradient of M i M_{i} tends to decrease as the error of Λ j i \Lambda_{j}^{i} decreases (see ( 22 ) in the proof of Lemma 4 ). This shows that the learning of M i M_{i} and Λ j i \Lambda_{j}^{i} is coupled. The decreasing variance of 𝒈 M i \boldsymbol{g}_{M_{i}} as Λ j i \Lambda_{j}^{i} converges is the reason for working with the local Z ~ 1 i , … , Z ~ N i \tilde{Z}_{1}^{i},\ldots,\tilde{Z}_{N}^{i} variables, which subtract the influence of X i X_{i} from the received variables.

paragraphs.en: The following lemma is not necessary to prove Theorem 2 . However, it sheds more light on how CL works. While Theorem 2 shows that the loss of each agent goes to its global minimum, Lemma 5 shows that each effective coordination error Λ j i ​ ( t ) ​ A j ∗ − B j i \Lambda_{j}^{i}(t)A_{j}^{*}-B_{j}^{i} converges to zero with probability one. Since Λ j i ​ ( t ) \Lambda^{i}_{j}(t) is bounded and ρ ⁡ ( t ) → ∞ \rho(t)\to\infty , we have Π t ​ [ Λ j i ​ ( t ) ] = Λ j i ​ ( t ) \Pi_{t}\left[\Lambda^{i}_{j}(t)\right]=\Lambda^{i}_{j}(t) for all large t t . Together with M j ​ ( t ) → A j ∗ M_{j}(t)\to A^{*}_{j} (Theorem 2 ) and the bound ( 22 ) in the proof of Lemma 4 , it implies that the variance of 𝒈 M i ​ ( t ) \boldsymbol{g}_{M_{i}}(t) has a decreasing upper bound that reaches an error floor, determined by the label noise and covariance estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 以下引理对于证明定理2并非必要。 然而，它进一步阐明了CL的工作原理。 虽然定理2表明每个智能体的损失都会趋近于其全局最小值，但引理5指出，每个有效的协调误差 Λ j i ​ ( t ) ​ A j ∗ − B j i \Lambda_{j}^{i}(t)A_{j}^{*}-B_{j}^{i} 会以概率一收敛于零。 由于 Λ j i ​ ( t ) \Lambda^{i}_{j}(t) 是有界的，且 ρ ⁡ ( t ) → ∞ \rho(t)\to\infty ，因此对于所有足够大的 t t ，我们有 Π t ​ [ Λ j i ​ ( t ) ] = Λ j i ​ ( t ) \Pi_{t}\left[\Lambda^{i}_{j}(t)\right]=\Lambda^{i}_{j}(t) 。 结合 M j ​ ( t ) → A j ∗ M_{j}(t)\to A^{*}_{j}（定理2）以及引理4证明中的界（22），这意味着 𝒈 M i ​ ( t ) \boldsymbol{g}_{M_{i}}(t) 的方差存在一个递减的上界，该上界最终会达到一个由标签噪声和协方差估计决定的误差下限。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we test CL numerically. The first set of simulations uses our linear theoretical model, assumed in Theorem 2. The second set goes beyond the linear model and runs CL with deep neural networks that classify the digits of a composite MNIST image.

paragraphs.en: We simulated N ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 } N\in\{8,16,32\} agents. Agent i i has an input X i ∈ ℝ d X_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} and a label Y i ∈ ℝ m Y_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{m} , with d = 2 d=2 and m = 1 m=1 . As assumed in Section 3.1, the inputs have zero mean and are whitened, so that 𝔼 ⁡ { X i ​ X i T } = I \mathbb{E}\{X_{i}X_{i}^{T}\}=I . The inputs of different agents are correlated coordinate by coordinate. For each coordinate k = 1 , … , d k=1,\ldots,d , the vector ( X 1 , k , … , X N , k ) (X_{1,k},\ldots,X_{N,k}) has a correlation matrix R ∈ ℝ N × N R\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} , and different coordinates are independent, so that Cov ⁡ ( X j , X i ) = R j ​ i ​ I \mathrm{Cov}(X_{j},X_{i})=R_{ji}I . In every run we draw a new matrix R R with unit diagonal and off-diagonal entries ( U j ​ i + U i ​ j ) / 2 (U_{ji}+U_{ij})/2 , where the entries of U U are drawn uniformly from [ − 5 / N , 5 / N ] [-5/N,5/N] . Such a matrix is not always positive semidefinite. In that case, we replace it by a nearby correlation matrix: we raise its eigenvalues to at least 10 − 12 10^{-12} and rescale it to a unit diagonal. This was needed in about 60% of the runs with N = 8 N=8 , in less than 10% of the runs with N = 16 N=16 , and in none with N = 32 N=32 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们模拟了 N ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 } N\in\{8,16,32\} 个智能体。 智能体 i 的输入为 X i ∈ ℝ d X_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}，标签为 Y i ∈ ℝ m Y_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{m}，其中 d = 2 d=2，m = 1 m=1。 如第 3.1 节所述，输入的均值为零且经过白化处理，因此 𝔼 ⁡ { X i ​ X i T } = I \mathbb{E}\{X_{i}X_{i}^{T}\}=I。 不同智能体的输入在坐标层面存在相关性。 对于每个坐标 k = 1 , … , d k=1,\ldots,d，向量 ( X 1 , k , … , X N , k ) (X_{1,k},\ldots,X_{N,k}) 的相关矩阵为 R ∈ ℝ N × N R\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N}，且不同坐标相互独立，因此 Cov ⁡ ( X j , X i ) = R j ​ i ​ I \mathrm{Cov}(X_{j},X_{i})=R_{ji}I。 在每次运行中，我们生成一个新的矩阵 R R，其对角线元素为 1，非对角线元素为 ( U j ​ i + U i ​ j ) / 2 (U_{ji}+U_{ij})/2，其中 U U 的元素从 [ − 5 / N , 5 / N ] [-5/N,5/N] 中均匀抽取。 这样的矩阵并不总是半正定的。 在这种情况下，我们会将其替换为一个邻近的相关矩阵：将其特征值提升至至少 10 − 12 10^{-12}，并重新缩放使其对角线元素为 1。 在 N = 8 N=8 的运行中，约有 60% 需要执行此操作；在 N = 16 N=16 的运行中，少于 10% 需要执行；而在 N = 32 N=32 的运行中，则完全不需要。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows the loss of cordial and isolated agents for all six configurations. Isolated agents converge to the best isolated predictor within about 100 iterations. Their median loss is at most 1.6 % 1.6\% above the best isolated loss from then on. Cordial agents start with a higher loss, since their coordination matrices are initialized at random, but it drops quickly. After 20 iterations, it is lower than that of the isolated agents in 94–100% of the runs of each configuration, and from iteration 140 on, it is lower in all 600 runs. The loss of cordial agents then keeps decreasing towards the global minimum. After 20,000 iterations, the median ratio between the loss of cordial and isolated agents ranges from 0.36 % 0.36\% ( N = 8 N=8 , Gaussian inputs) to 1.4 % 1.4\% ( N = 32 N=32 , Laplacian inputs), and it is below 2.4 % 2.4\% in every run. On the log-log scale, the loss of cordial agents decreases almost linearly, with a slope between − 0.58 -0.58 and − 0.49 -0.49 from iteration 2,000 to 20,000 in all configurations. The loss therefore decreases like a power of t t . The loss at the last iteration is larger with more agents and with Laplacian inputs, while the rate of decrease is about the same in all configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 图3展示了所有六种配置中，协同智能体与孤立智能体的损失情况。 孤立智能体在大约100次迭代内收敛到最佳孤立预测器。 从那时起，它们的中位数损失最多比最佳孤立损失高出1.6%（1.6\%）。 协同智能体的初始损失更高，因为其协调矩阵是随机初始化的，但损失会迅速下降。 经过20次迭代后，在每种配置的每次运行中，其损失在94%至100%的情况下低于孤立智能体；从第140次迭代开始，在所有600次运行中均低于孤立智能体。 此后，协同智能体的损失持续下降，趋近于全局最小值。 经过20,000次迭代后，协同智能体与孤立智能体损失的中位数比率范围从0.36%（0.36\%，N=8，高斯输入）到1.4%（1.4\%，N=32，拉普拉斯输入），且所有运行中的该比率均低于2.4%（2.4\%）。 在对数-对数坐标系中，协同智能体的损失几乎呈线性下降，在所有配置中，从第2,000次到第20,000次迭代时，其斜率介于−0.58至−0.49之间。 因此，损失随t的幂次而下降。 在最后一次迭代中，智能体数量越多或使用拉普拉斯输入时，损失越大；但所有配置中的下降速率大致相同。

paragraphs.en: Each data sample is a horizontal concatenation of N N MNIST digits, which forms a 28 × 28 ​ N 28\times 28N image. Agent i i sees the i i -th 28 × 28 28\times 28 digit and has to classify it. The digits of a sample are correlated, and the rule that generates them defines the dataset. Section 6.2.1 uses a deterministic rule (Pairwise-10), and Section 6.2.2 a probabilistic one (a common cause). We vary the amount of data by the number P P of MNIST images per digit. The training composites are built from a pool of P P MNIST training images of each digit, and the validation composites from a second pool of P P training images of each digit, disjoint from the first. The test composites are built from a pool of P P MNIST test images of each digit. Therefore, no image appears in two of the three sets. A composite takes a random image from the pool of each of its digits. Pixel values are scaled to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . We call one such random construction of the training, validation and test sets a draw of the images.
paragraphs.zh: 每个数据样本都是 N 个 MNIST 数字的水平拼接，从而形成一个 28 × 28 的图像。 智能体 i 能看到第 i 个 28 × 28 的数字，并需要对其进行分类。 一个样本中的各个数字是相关的，而生成这些数字的规则定义了该数据集。 第 6.2.1 节使用了一个确定性规则（Pairwise-10），而第 6.2.2 节则使用了一个概率性规则（共同原因）。 我们通过每个数字对应的 MNIST 图像数量 P 来调整数据量。 训练合成图像由每个数字的 P 张 MNIST 训练图像池构建而成，验证合成图像则由另一个与前者互斥的、包含每个数字 P 张训练图像的池构建而成。 测试合成图像由每个数字的 P 张 MNIST 测试图像池构建而成。 因此，没有任何一张图像会同时出现在这三个集合中的两个里。 一个合成图像会从其每个数字的图像池中随机选取一张图像。 像素值被缩放至 [−1, 1]。 我们将训练集、验证集和测试集的这样一种随机构建过程称为一次图像抽取。

paragraphs.en: Cordial Learning : Each agent sends h i h_{i} to all others, both in training and at test time. During training, the communicated embedded outputs are computed with dropout, as in the forward pass. In its layer fc3 , agent i i computes z i = W i ​ h i + b i + ∑ j ≠ i Λ j i ​ h j + c i z_{i}=W_{i}h_{i}+b_{i}+\sum_{j\neq i}\Lambda^{i}_{j}h_{j}+c_{i} , where W i , Λ j i ∈ ℝ 10 × 10 W_{i},\Lambda^{i}_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{10\times 10} are weight matrices and b i , c i ∈ ℝ 10 b_{i},c_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{10} are biases, and its prediction is the softmax of fc4 ( ReLU ⁡ ( z i ) ) (\mathrm{ReLU}(z_{i})) , where fc4 has 10 units. The matrices Λ j i \Lambda^{i}_{j} and the bias c i c_{i} form the coordination layer, which adds the message term ∑ j ≠ i Λ j i ​ h j + c i \sum_{j\neq i}\Lambda^{i}_{j}h_{j}+c_{i} to z i z_{i} . It is initialized to zero. The received embedded outputs h j h_{j} are treated as constants, so the parameters of agent i i are updated only by the gradient of its own loss, as in Algorithm 1.
paragraphs.zh: 友好学习：每个智能体在训练和测试阶段都将 h i h_{i} 发送给所有其他智能体。 在训练期间，通过通信传递的嵌入输出会像前向传播一样使用 dropout 进行计算。 在其 fc3 层中，智能体 i i 计算 z i = W i ​ h i + b i + ∑ j ≠ i Λ j i ​ h j + c i z_{i}=W_{i}h_{i}+b_{i}+\sum_{j\neq i}\Lambda^{i}_{j}h_{j}+c_{i}，其中 W i , Λ j i ∈ ℝ 10 × 10 W_{i},\Lambda^{i}_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{10\times 10} 是权重矩阵，b i , c i ∈ ℝ 10 b_{i},c_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{10} 是偏置项，其预测结果是 fc4 ( ReLU ⁡ ( z i ) ) (\mathrm{ReLU}(z_{i})) 的 softmax 值，而 fc4 包含 10 个单元。 矩阵 Λ j i \Lambda^{i}_{j} 和偏置 c i c_{i} 构成了协调层，该层将消息项 ∑ j ≠ i Λ j i ​ h j + c i \sum_{j\neq i}\Lambda^{i}_{j}h_{j}+c_{i} 加到 z i z_{i} 上。 它被初始化为零。 接收到的嵌入输出 h j h_{j} 被视为常数，因此智能体 i i 的参数仅通过其自身损失的梯度进行更新，如算法 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: Centralized Architecture : A single standard CNN that receives the entire 28 × 28 ​ N 28\times 28N image and predicts all the digits jointly. It has three convolutional layers with 5 × 5 5\times 5 filters (padded to keep the size), each followed by ReLU and 2 × 2 2\times 2 max pooling, a fully connected hidden layer, and an output layer with 10 ​ N 10N units, with a softmax over each group of 10. Dropout follows every pooling layer and the hidden layer. The numbers of filters and hidden units are tuned from (6, 16, 120) filters with 128 hidden units, (16, 32, 64) with 128 or 256, and (32, 64, 128) with 256. It is trained on the sum of the losses of all agents.
paragraphs.zh: 集中式架构：一个单一的标准 CNN，接收完整的 28 × 28 N 28\times 28N 图像，并联合预测所有数字。 它包含三个卷积层，每个卷积层使用 5 × 5 5\times 5 的滤波器（通过填充保持尺寸不变），随后依次连接 ReLU 和 2 × 2 2\times 2 的最大池化层、一个全连接隐藏层，以及一个包含 10 N 10N 个单元的输出层，并对每 10 个单元应用 softmax。 每个池化层和隐藏层之后都接有 Dropout。 滤波器和隐藏单元的数量从以下组合中进行调整：(6, 16, 120) 个滤波器搭配 128 个隐藏单元；(16, 32, 64) 个滤波器搭配 128 或 256 个隐藏单元；以及 (32, 64, 128) 个滤波器搭配 256 个隐藏单元。 该模型通过所有智能体的损失之和进行训练。

paragraphs.en: All models are trained with Adam on batches of 65 composites, reshuffled every epoch. The loss is the sum over the agents of the cross-entropy of each agent’s digit. In epoch e e , the learning rate of all layers except the coordination layers is ε e = ε 0 / ( 1 + e / t 0 ) 0.6 \varepsilon_{e}=\varepsilon_{0}/(1+e/t_{0})^{0.6} . The coordination layers are not trained in the first K K epochs, and after that their learning rate is η e = η 0 / ( 1 + ( e − K ) / t 0 ) \eta_{e}=\eta_{0}/(1+(e-K)/t_{0}) . Therefore, η e / ε e → 0 \eta_{e}/\varepsilon_{e}\to 0 and ∑ e η e 2 / ε e < ∞ \sum_{e}\eta_{e}^{2}/\varepsilon_{e}<\infty , as in Theorem 2. With Adam, however, these are nominal learning rates and not the step sizes of Theorem 2. The delay K K lets the embeddings become informative before the agents start to rely on them. Isolated agents and the centralized network use the schedule ε e \varepsilon_{e} for all their layers.

paragraphs.en: The hyperparameters of every method were tuned with 4 agents on the validation set of the first draw of the images (see below), separately for every dataset and data size, with the same number of runs for all methods. The initial learning rate ε 0 \varepsilon_{0} is drawn log-uniformly from [ 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 , 5 ⋅ 10 − 2 ] [5\cdot 10^{-4},5\cdot 10^{-2}] ( [ 10 − 4 , 10 − 2 ] [10^{-4},10^{-2}] for the centralized network), t 0 t_{0} from { 1 , 3 , 10 , 30 , 100 , 300 } \{1,3,10,30,100,300\} (without the largest values for larger P P ), and the dropout rate from { 0.1 , 0.25 , 0.5 } \{0.1,0.25,0.5\} . For cordial agents, η 0 \eta_{0} is also drawn log-uniformly from [ 10 − 4 , 10 − 1 ] [10^{-4},10^{-1}] , and K K from a grid that scales with the number of epochs (e.g., { 0 , 25 , 50 , 100 , 200 , 400 } \{0,25,50,100,200,400\} for P = 25 P=25 ). For the centralized network, we also tune the numbers of filters and hidden units. For each method, we trained 40 random configurations, then 40 perturbations of the five best, and then retrained the three best with three more random seeds. For Pairwise-10 and for the common-cause dataset with p = 0.6 p=0.6 , with P = 25 P=25 and P = 500 P=500 , the candidates also include the configurations of an earlier random search, the same for all methods (12 and 10 per method, respectively, with epoch limits of 1,000 and 120). The configuration with the lowest validation loss, averaged over its four seeds, was selected. Tuning runs stop after 200, 80, and 15 epochs without an improvement of the validation loss for P = 25 P=25 , 100, and 500, respectively, or at an epoch limit of 1,500, 600, and 180 epochs.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法的超参数均使用 4 个智能体在图像第一次抽取的验证集（见下文）上进行调优，每个数据集和数据规模分别处理，且所有方法均运行相同次数。 初始学习率 ε₀ \varepsilon_{0} 从 [5·10⁻⁴, 5·10⁻²] 中按对数均匀分布抽取（对于集中式网络为 [10⁻⁴, 10⁻²]），t₀ 从 {1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300} 中抽取（对于较大的 P，不包含最大值），而 dropout 率则从 {0.1, 0.25, 0.5} 中抽取。 对于友好型智能体，η₀ \eta_{0} 同样从 [10⁻⁴, 10⁻¹] 中按对数均匀分布抽取，而 K 则从随训练轮数变化的网格中抽取（例如，当 P=25 时，网格为 {0, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400}）。 对于集中式网络，我们还调优了滤波器数量和隐藏单元数量。 对于每种方法，我们训练了 40 种随机配置，接着对表现最佳的五种配置进行 40 次扰动，最后使用三个额外的随机种子重新训练表现最佳的三种配置。 对于 Pairwise-10 以及 p=0.6 的共同原因数据集，在 P=25 和 P=500 的情况下，候选配置还包括早期随机搜索的配置，所有方法均如此（每种方法分别有 12 种和 10 种配置，训练轮数上限分别为 1,000 和 120）。 选择验证损失最低且在其四个种子配置上平均表现最优的配置。 调优运行在 P=25、100 和 500 的情况下，若连续 200、80 和 15 个训练轮次内验证损失无改善，则停止；或在达到 1,500、600 和 180 个训练轮次的上限时停止。

paragraphs.en: With the selected hyperparameters, each method was trained with 10 random seeds for a fixed number of epochs: either the maximal number of epochs for tuning, or 1.5 times this number if one of the selected configurations reached its best validation loss in the last 10% of the tuning epochs. The number of agents N ∈ { 2 , 4 , 6 } N\in\{2,4,6\} changes, but the hyperparameters tuned with 4 agents are kept. We keep the network with the lowest validation loss during training, which we evaluate every 5, 2, and 1 epochs for P = 25,100 P=25,100 , and 500 (for cordial agents, from epoch K K on), and evaluate it on the test set without dropout. We report the test loss per agent (the sum over agents of the mean test cross-entropy, divided by N N ) and the test accuracy averaged over the agents. For cordial agents, we also report the test accuracy when the message term is removed, which shows how much the agents rely on the received embedded outputs. The selected hyperparameters are listed in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: With few images, the results depend on which images are drawn into the three pools. We therefore repeated the final runs of all methods on two further independent draws of the training, validation and test pools, with the same hyperparameters, numbers of epochs and random seeds, and report the results of all three draws together (30 runs per method). To compare two methods, we compare every run of one method with every run of the other on the same draw (100 pairs per draw) and report the number of pairs in which the first method has the lower test loss.
paragraphs.zh: 在图像数量较少的情况下，结果取决于哪些图像被分配到三个池子中。 因此，我们对所有方法进行了两次额外的独立重采样，分别对训练、验证和测试池进行抽取，并使用相同的超参数、训练轮次数和随机种子重复了所有方法的最终运行，并汇总报告了三次抽样的全部结果（每种方法各 30 次运行）。 为了比较两种方法，我们将一种方法的每次运行与另一种方法在相同抽样下的每次运行进行比较（每次抽样产生 100 对），并报告其中第一种方法测试损失更低的配对数量。

paragraphs.en: In the Pairwise-10 dataset, the digits of a sample satisfy two rules. The digits at positions ( 1 , 2 ) , ( 3 , 4 ) , … (1,2),(3,4),\ldots sum to 10, and so do the digits at positions ( 2 , 4 ) , ( 4 , 6 ) , … (2,4),(4,6),\ldots . The valid tuples of digits are therefore ( a , 10 − a ) (a,10-a) , ( a , 10 − a , 10 − a , a ) (a,10-a,10-a,a) and ( a , 10 − a , 10 − a , a , a , 10 − a ) (a,10-a,10-a,a,a,10-a) for N = 2 , 4 , 6 N=2,4,6 , with a ∈ { 1 , … , 9 } a\in\{1,\ldots,9\} . In particular, the digit of any single agent determines the digits of all other agents. Each of the three sets has P P composites of every valid tuple, that is, 9 ​ P 9P composites. We report P = 25 P=25 , 100, and 500, from 225 to 4,500 composites per set. The final runs have 2,250, 600, and 180 epochs, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Pairwise-10 数据集中，一个样本的各位数字满足两条规则。 位置为 (1,2)、(3,4)、… 的各位数字之和为 10，位置为 (2,4)、(4,6)、… 的各位数字之和也为 10。 因此，有效的数字元组为 (a, 10−a)、(a, 10−a, 10−a, a) 和 (a, 10−a, 10−a, a, a, 10−a)，其中 N=2、4、6，且 a∈{1, …, 9}。 特别地，任意单个智能体的数字决定了所有其他智能体的数字。 这三组中的每一组都包含每个有效元组的 P 个合数，即 9P 个合数。 我们报告的 P 值分别为 25、100 和 500，每组对应的合数范围从 225 到 4,500。 最终运行的轮次分别为 2,250、600 和 180。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows the test loss during training for P = 25 P=25 , 100 and 500, and Table 2 lists the test loss and accuracy of the selected networks. CL is much better than isolated training in every setting. For P = 25 P=25 , the median test loss per agent of isolated agents is 0.45 0.45 , 0.30 0.30 and 0.30 0.30 for 2, 4 and 6 agents. Cordial learning reduces it to 0.23 0.23 , 0.014 0.014 and 0.0028 0.0028 , and raises the median accuracy from 0.88 0.88 , 0.91 0.91 and 0.91 0.91 to 0.94 0.94 , 0.996 0.996 and 1.000 1.000 . For P = 500 P=500 , isolated agents reach an accuracy of 0.98 0.98 and a test loss of 0.06 0.06 – 0.07 0.07 , and CL reduces the test loss to 0.008 0.008 , 0.0009 0.0009 and less than 10 − 4 10^{-4} . In every setting, every run of CL has a lower test loss than every run of isolated agents on the same draw, except for 2 agents with P = 25 P=25 , where this holds for 297 of the 300 pairs of runs. The gain grows with the number of agents, which is expected, since every additional agent brings another view of the same information. The draw of the images matters for P = 25 P=25 : the median test loss of isolated agents with 2 agents is 0.31 0.31 , 0.47 0.47 and 0.49 0.49 on the three draws, and that of CL is 0.093 0.093 , 0.30 0.30 and 0.26 0.26 . The advantage of CL holds on every draw.
paragraphs.zh: 图5展示了P = 25、100和500时训练过程中的测试损失，表2列出了所选网络的测试损失和准确率。 在所有设置中，CL的表现都远优于孤立训练。 对于P = 25的情况，孤立智能体的每个智能体的测试损失中位数在智能体数量为2、4和6时分别为0.45、0.30和0.30。 Cordial学习将其降至0.23、0.014和0.0028，并将准确率中位数从0.88、0.91和0.91提升至0.94、0.996和1.000。 对于P = 500的情况，孤立智能体的准确率达到0.98，测试损失为0.06–0.07，而CL将测试损失降至0.008、0.0009以及低于10⁻⁴。 在所有设置中，对于相同的图像抽取，CL的每次运行测试损失都低于孤立智能体的每次运行，唯一的例外是P = 25且智能体数量为2的情况，此时在300对运行中有297对满足该结论。 随着智能体数量的增加，优势也会增长，这是符合预期的，因为每个额外的智能体都会带来对同一信息的另一种视角。 对于P = 25的情况，图像的抽取方式会影响结果：在三种不同的图像抽取中，孤立智能体（2个智能体）的测试损失中位数分别为0.31、0.47和0.49，而CL的测试损失中位数则为0.093、0.30和0.26。 CL的优势在所有图像抽取中都成立。

paragraphs.en: With less data, the centralized network often failed to train. With the selected configuration, 47 of its 180 runs with P = 25 P=25 and P = 100 P=100 did not learn at all: the network predicts the uniform distribution over the nine possible digits for every agent, with a test loss of ln ⁡ 9 ≈ 2.2 \ln 9\approx 2.2 . This happened in 7, 12 and 15 of the 30 runs with P = 25 P=25 and 2, 4 and 6 agents, and in 0, 6 and 7 of the 30 runs with P = 100 P=100 . This occurred even though none of the four tuning runs of the selected configuration failed. None of the 180 runs of CL with P ≤ 100 P\leq 100 failed, and their lowest accuracy is 0.90 0.90 . For P = 25 P=25 and 2, 4 and 6 agents, the median test loss of CL is 0.23 0.23 , 0.014 0.014 and 0.0028 0.0028 , and that of the centralized network is 0.30 0.30 , 0.027 0.027 and 1.1 1.1 . Without the runs that did not learn, the median test loss of the centralized network is 0.23 0.23 , 0.0002 0.0002 and less than 10 − 4 10^{-4} .

paragraphs.en: The gain of CL comes from the received embedded outputs. When the message term is removed, the accuracy of cordial agents drops to between 0.65 0.65 and 0.95 0.95 , below that of isolated agents in every setting. Cordial agents learn to combine their own image with the embedded outputs of the others, instead of classifying their own digit alone. This fits the structure of Pairwise-10, where a single received embedded output can carry as much information about the digit of agent i i as its own image.
paragraphs.zh: CL 的增益来自接收到的嵌入输出。 当移除消息项时，cordial 智能体的准确率会降至 0.65 到 0.95 之间，在所有设置中都低于 isolated 智能体的准确率。 Cordial 智能体学会将自己的图像与他人的嵌入输出相结合，而不是仅对自身的数字进行分类。 这与 Pairwise-10 的结构相符，在该结构中，单个接收到的嵌入输出可以携带关于智能体 i 的数字的信息量，与其自身图像相当。

paragraphs.en: In Pairwise-10, the digit of one agent determines the digits of all others. In the common-cause datasets, the dependence is probabilistic and much weaker. A hidden class z z is drawn uniformly from { 0 , … , 9 } \{0,\ldots,9\} , and the digit of each agent is independently equal to z z with probability p p and uniform on the nine other digits otherwise. The digit of every agent is therefore uniform, and the digits of two agents are equal with probability p 2 + ( 1 − p ) 2 / 9 p^{2}+(1-p)^{2}/9 . For p = 0.1 p=0.1 the digits are independent, and as p p grows, the other agents carry more information about the digit of agent i i . We report p = 0.8 p=0.8 and p = 0.6 p=0.6 . As a reference for this information, the best prediction of the digit of an agent from the true digits of the other N − 1 N-1 agents alone has an accuracy of 0.64 0.64 , 0.74 0.74 and 0.79 0.79 for N = 2 , 4 , 6 N=2,4,6 with p = 0.8 p=0.8 , and 0.38 0.38 , 0.45 0.45 and 0.54 0.54 with p = 0.6 p=0.6 . Each of the three sets has 9 ​ P 9P composites, the same number as in Pairwise-10. All hyperparameters were tuned separately for each value of p p and P P , as described above. The final runs have 1,500, 900, and 180 epochs for p = 0.8 p=0.8 and 2,250, 900, and 180 epochs for p = 0.6 p=0.6 , for P = 25 P=25 , 100, and 500.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Pairwise-10 中，一个智能体的数字决定了所有其他智能体的数字。 在共同原因数据集中，这种依赖关系是概率性的，且要弱得多。 一个隐藏类 z 从 {0, …, 9} 中均匀抽取，每个智能体的数字以概率 p 独立地等于 z，否则在其余九个数字上均匀分布。 因此，每个智能体的数字都是均匀分布的，两个智能体的数字相等的概率为 p² + (1 − p)² / 9。 当 p = 0.1 时，这些数字是独立的；随着 p 增大，其他智能体携带的关于智能体 i 的数字的信息也越来越多。 我们报告了 p = 0.8 和 p = 0.6 的情况。 作为该信息的参考，仅根据其他 N − 1 个智能体的真实数字对一个智能体的数字进行最佳预测的准确率，在 N = 2、4、6 且 p = 0.8 时分别为 0.64、0.74 和 0.79；在 p = 0.6 时分别为 0.38、0.45 和 0.54。 这三组数据每组都包含 9P 个复合数，与 Pairwise-10 中的数量相同。 如上文所述，所有超参数均针对每个 p 和 P 的值单独调整。 最终运行中，当 p = 0.8 时，epochs 分别为 1,500、900 和 180；当 p = 0.6 时，epochs 分别为 2,250、900 和 180，对应的 P 值分别为 25、100 和 500。

paragraphs.en: Figures 6 and 7 show the test loss during training for p = 0.8 p=0.8 and p = 0.6 p=0.6 , and Table 3 lists the test loss and accuracy of all methods.

paragraphs.en: For p = 0.8 p=0.8 and P ≥ 100 P\geq 100 , CL is better than isolated training in every setting and on every draw of the images. It has the lower test loss in 256 to 300 of the 300 pairs of runs for P = 100 P=100 and P = 500 P=500 . Its median test loss is 18% to 35% lower, and its error rate is 15% to 28% lower than that of isolated agents. The gain is larger with 4 and 6 agents than with 2 agents. For P = 500 P=500 and 6 agents the test loss drops from 0.068 0.068 to 0.044 0.044 and the accuracy rises from 0.982 0.982 to 0.987 0.987 . For P = 25 P=25 , CL is better with 6 agents (274 of 300 pairs, a 9% lower loss); with 2 and 4 agents, the two methods are on par, where CL wins in 155 and 191 of 300 pairs, respectively.

paragraphs.en: For p = 0.6 p=0.6 , the less correlated scenario, the gain of CL depends on the amount of data. For P = 100 P=100 , it is better with 4 agents (210 of 300 pairs) and on par with 2 and 6 agents. For P = 25 P=25 , CL is worse than isolated training with 4 agents on every draw (78 of 300 pairs) and with 6 agents on two of the three draws (98 of 300 pairs), and on par with 2 agents. A likely reason is that the coordination layers overfit. With 225 training composites, the embedded output of a neighbor may identify its digit almost perfectly on the training images but not on new images, and the dependence between the digits is too weak to make up for these errors. Tuning selected the latest start of the coordination layers in its grid ( K = 400 K=400 of 2,250 epochs), which suggests that on the validation set, the received embedded outputs help little.

paragraphs.en: When the message term is removed, the accuracy of cordial agents drops in every setting with P ≥ 100 P\geq 100 , and in 7 of these 12 settings it falls below that of isolated agents. paragraphs.en: We studied a distributed learning scenario in which agents’ data are correlated. This generalizes the federated learning scenario where agents have independent data. To allow agents to learn from each other, we propose cordial learning, where agents send their embedded outputs to others. The agents train layers to learn how to extract valuable information from the embedded outputs of other agents. For a linear model where the label of an agent is a linear mixture of the inputs of all agents, under mild assumptions, we proved that cordial learning converges to models that minimize the sum of losses of all agents. Experiments on multi-digit MNIST with deep neural networks show that cordial learning performs well even beyond the theoretical model we analyzed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了一种分布式学习场景，其中智能体的数据是相关的。 这推广了联邦学习场景，在该场景中智能体的数据是独立的。 为了让智能体能够相互学习，我们提出了“友好学习”，其中智能体会将自己的嵌入输出发送给其他智能体。 这些智能体训练各层网络，以学习如何从其他智能体的嵌入输出中提取有价值的信息。 对于一个线性模型，其中某个智能体的标签是所有智能体输入的线性组合，在温和的假设条件下，我们证明了友好学习会收敛到能够最小化所有智能体损失总和的模型。 在包含多位数字的 MNIST 数据集上使用深度神经网络进行的实验表明，友好学习的性能即使在超出我们所分析的理论模型范围时仍然表现良好。

sents.zh: 我们研究了一种分布式学习场景，其中智能体的数据是相关的。

sents.zh: 这推广了联邦学习场景，在该场景中智能体的数据是独立的。

sents.en: For a linear model where the label of an agent is a linear mixture of the inputs of all agents, under mild assumptions, we proved that cordial learning converges to models that minimize the sum of losses of all agents.
sents.zh: 对于一个线性模型，其中某个智能体的标签是所有智能体输入的线性组合，在温和的假设条件下，我们证明了友好学习会收敛到能够最小化所有智能体损失总和的模型。

sents.en: Experiments on multi-digit MNIST with deep neural networks show that cordial learning performs well even beyond the theoretical model we analyzed.

paragraphs.en: Our analysis focused on asymptotic convergence to the optimal models. The question of analyzing and optimizing the convergence rate remains open. The related question of proving optimal regret bounds in online learning settings is also open.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析聚焦于向最优模型渐近收敛的问题。 如何分析和优化收敛速率这一问题仍然悬而未决。 与之相关的是，如何证明在线学习场景下的最优遗憾界这一问题也尚未解决。

sents.en: Our analysis focused on asymptotic convergence to the optimal models.
sents.zh: 我们的分析聚焦于向最优模型渐近收敛的问题。

sents.en: The question of analyzing and optimizing the convergence rate remains open.

sents.en: The related question of proving optimal regret bounds in online learning settings is also open.

paragraphs.en: Cordial learning is a first step towards studying distributed learning scenarios with correlated data. A challenging open question from this perspective is designing a cordial learning scheme where agents learn how to efficiently compress the information they send based on the loss functions of the receiving agents.
paragraphs.zh: 友好学习是研究相关数据分布式学习场景的第一步。 从这个角度来看，一个具有挑战性的开放问题是设计一种友好学习方案，使智能体能够根据接收方智能体的损失函数，高效压缩其发送的信息。
